name: Ochiyuku Kyoushitsu
source:
During school tour class visits toy factory and gets lost in its huge labyrinth-like basement. They are able to find food there, but food contains strong aphrodisiacs. Males together with the teacher start insulting the girls one by one. It all turns out to be a trap of a shady organization that transmits the whole breakout run online in the internet and its members bid on girls they like. Will main character be able to protect the girls or fall victim of this madness as well?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
学校组织参观玩具工厂时，一个班级在宛如迷宫的巨大地下室中迷了路。众人虽然找到了食物，其中却含有强烈的催情药物。男生与教师开始逐个凌辱女孩。原来，这一切都是某个可疑组织设下的陷阱；组织在网上直播整场逃亡，还让成员竞拍自己喜欢的女孩。主人公究竟能否保护她们，还是也会沦为疯狂的牺牲品？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
